title: Content
description: Generate notes and articles from images, video, and text
pageDescription: Fill in the brief from a template, attach materials, and generate a note or article you can keep editing. Publishing to external channels comes later.

template.fieldTip: A template sets which fields to fill in and the writing rules the result must follow. Pick one and the output stays consistent.
template.pageDescription: Turn your team's best practice into a form: what to fill in, how to write it, and what the result must look like.
template.editDescription: The field table sets what to fill in; the writing rules and output limits set what comes out.
template.emptyHint: Copy one of the built-in templates below and adjust it.
template.presetsHint: Copy one to make it yours, then edit freely — later changes to the built-in version never touch your copy.
template.name: Name
template.fieldsSectionTip: Creating a piece walks through this table. The order here is the order people fill it in.
template.fieldHelpPlaceholder: What a good answer looks like
template.fieldOptionsPlaceholder:
I want this
Comforting
I learned something
template.guidelinesTip: One per line, handed to the model as hard requirements. Voice, structure and things to avoid — not the content itself.
template.guidelinesPlaceholder:
Write in first person, like sharing with a friend
Put the pain point in the first three lines
No absolute claims, no promised results
template.outputRulesTip: Bounds on length and hashtag count. Leave blank for no limit.
template.tonePlaceholder: e.g. first person, spoken, eager to share
template.rulesEmptyHint: Anything left blank falls back to the format's default.
template.samplesTip: Up to 3. The model copies their voice and structure, never their facts. Longer samples cost more per generation.
template.sampleBodyPlaceholder: Paste an older piece that came out well…
